description: Charts and statistics of Git activity (commits, churn, active days, authors) for one repository or a whole workspace.
command.analyzeProject.title: Analyze Current Project
command.analyzeWorkspace.title: Analyze Whole Workspace (Multi-Repo)
config.startDate: Start date of the analysis (e.g. YYYY-MM-DD or '30 days ago'; anything GNU `date -d` understands).
config.endDate: End date of the analysis (e.g. YYYY-MM-DD or 'now').
config.outputDir: Folder where the generated PNG is written. Empty: the workspace folder for multi-repo analysis, the extension's storage folder for a single repository (so the report never appears as an untracked file in the analyzed repo). Supports a leading `~`.
capabilities.untrusted: The extension runs bash and Python scripts on the repositories of the workspace, so it needs a trusted workspace.
capabilities.virtual: The extension needs a real filesystem: it runs git and local scripts.
command.analyzeMyWork.title: Analyze My Work
config.author: Whose work "Analyze My Work" shows: a name as it appears in the reports, or an email address (exact match, case-insensitive; with an email, every identity that your aliases file merges with it is included). Empty: the email from `git config user.email` of the repository.
